label: Отсюда
description: A 10-sentence usage card for отсюда (from here).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion away from here. 'Отсюда' is an adverb marking the starting point of movement, meaning from this place. It modifies 'уходи' and answers откуда.
Strategic focus: Vantage point. 'Отсюда' marks the place from which the sea is visible, modifying 'видно'. It names the origin of the view, the spot where the speaker stands.
Strategic focus: Leaving a place. 'Отсюда' marks the origin of the departure, modifying 'уйдём'. It answers откуда and stresses moving away from the current spot.
Strategic focus: Measuring distance from a point. 'Отсюда' marks the starting point for the distance to the station. It names where the measurement begins, paired with 'до вокзала'.
Strategic focus: Removing things from a place. 'Отсюда' marks the source from which the things are taken, modifying 'забери'. It answers откуда and names the current spot as origin.
Strategic focus: Point of perception. 'Отсюда' marks the location from which the music is heard, modifying 'слышно'. It names the speaker's spot as the origin of the sound's reach.
Strategic focus: Escaping a place. 'Отсюда' marks the origin of the desired motion, modifying 'выбраться'. The question asks the way out from this spot, answering откуда.
Strategic focus: Starting point of a route. 'Отсюда' marks where the road begins, modifying 'ведёт'. It names the current place as the origin of the path into the mountains.
Strategic focus: Departure from a region. 'Отсюда' marks the origin of the birds' flight, modifying 'улетают'. It names this place as the spot they leave each autumn.
Strategic focus: Beginning a journey. 'Отсюда' marks the spot where the path starts, modifying 'начинается'. It frames the current place as the origin of the whole journey.
